# Card

**Class:** `UltraCanvasCard` · **Group:** [Layout and structure](../Groups/Layout-and-structure.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasCard.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasCard.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasCard.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A card: header with icon, title, subtitle and a trailing badge, a content area, a row of real buttons at the foot, a clickable surface ([doc](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasCard.md))

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasCard](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasCard.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasCard> CreateCard(const std::string& identifier, const std::string& title = "", const std::string& subtitle = "");
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasCard> CreateCard(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, const std::string& title = "", const std::string& subtitle = "");
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasCard(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, const std::string& title = "", const std::string& subtitle = "");
UltraCanvasCard(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h, const std::string& title = "", const std::string& subtitle = "");
explicit UltraCanvasCard(const std::string& identifier, const std::string& title = "", const std::string& subtitle = "");
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `AddActionButton()` | `std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasButton> AddActionButton(const std::string& id, const std::string& text, std::function<void()> onClick, float minWidth = 72.0f)` | A real button with this text, wired to onClick; returned for styling. |
| `onClick` | `std::function<void()> onClick` | _Click_ |
| `onDoubleClick` | `std::function<void()> onDoubleClick` | _Double click_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md): `SetScrollChangedCallback`, `SetChildAddedCallback`, `SetChildRemovedCallback`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
